This is the official Youtube page of the School of Veterinary Medicine of the University of Nicosia.
The University of Nicosia started the first School of Veterinary Medicine in Cyprus. Over the past two decades, UNIC has led the development of life and health sciences programmes in Cyprus, attracting students from more than 100 countries around the world.
#UNICVet #UNICSchoolOfVet
